name: Pumpkin Ridge (autumn at the foot of the Tualatin Mountains)
note: Course theme palette (32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Pumpkin Ridge Golf Club, North Plains OR, drawn in late October: turf still green but a little olive (OSIP 2024 photo: fairway #8c9e6f, green #acae6e); wide native-grass areas between the holes left long and straw-gold (F0-F2, drawn where data/pumpkin_ridge/proposed/fescue.geojson says, config fescue_areas; photo rough median #908c66 where green minus red < 0); mown rough in G3-G5; cream bunker sand (#ccc4a2); slate-teal creek and lakes (#4c5c5e); harvested wheat and grass-seed fields around the course in a dry olive-gold (L0-L2); rust leaf litter under the trees (B1-B2). Trees: deep blue-green Douglas fir, and Oregon white oak, bigleaf maple and vine maple in autumn colour (assets-src/trees_pumpkin_ridge.py). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
